subject: Handoff & Orchestration MAP — HeliosRx go-live plan
messages:
From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@heliosrx.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Handoff & Orchestration MAP — initial asks

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Tom and I walked the exec team through Redwood and they liked the performance numbers. We closed the commercial terms yesterday and need to lock down the post-signature orchestration so Procurement and IT have a single mutual action plan (MAP) to follow.

High level asks from HeliosRx:
- 8-week ramp from signature to full production (regional cutover by 2026-10-01)
- A two-stage canary (internal QA then 20% customer traffic) with clear rollback gates
- Training for 3 operator cohorts (US east, US west, internal support) and two enablement sessions for SREs
- An evaluation plan for model quality (embedding drift checks + a 500-sample prompt set)

Can you send a draft MAP that embeds the evaluation plan and the cutover windows? Procurement needs milestones for PO release, invoice milestones, and a go/no-go on the canary.

I attached the signed order and a short list of HeliosRx stakeholders. If you need anything from IT (SAML metadata, IP allowlist) we can get it within 48 hours.

Thanks — aim to have a draft by Monday if possible.

— Aisha
Head of Product, HeliosRx

Attachments: HeliosRx_signed_PO.pdf (pdf, 72KB); HeliosRx-stakeholders.csv (csv, 4KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@heliosrx.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@heliosrx.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff & Orchestration MAP — draft attached

Hi Aisha / Tom,

Congrats on the close — welcome aboard. Attached is a first-pass MAP that stitches together: procurement milestones, a two-stage canary approach, a migration/cutover calendar, and an evaluation plan for model quality. Key points up front:

- Target go-live (full production): 2026-10-01
- Canary approach: 1) Internal QA (2 business days), 2) External soft-launch at 20% traffic for 48 hours
- Rollback/stop criteria: sustained error rate > 0.5% OR model-quality regression on the 500-sample set greater than 3% (precision-oriented metric)
- Training: three 90-minute cohort sessions the week before the canary + two 60-minute SRE enablement deep dives
- Evaluation: daily automated embeddings drift check, weekly curated sample evaluations, and a final acceptance runbook for cutover decisioning

Requested from HeliosRx IT: SAML metadata, a temporary allowlist for canary IPs, and a contact for runbook handoff (please confirm by EOD Monday).

I attached: HeliosRx_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones and owner columns), canary-checklist.pdf (checklist and rollback play), training-cadence.docx (session agendas).

If the milestones look OK I’ll route this to Marcus for operational runbook details and to Laura for training logistics; Marcus / Laura — would you both review the canary windows below and call out any changes?

Proposed canary calendar (US time):
- 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-21: Internal QA (staging smoke + load sample)
- 2026-09-22 09:00 PT to 2026-09-24 09:00 PT: 20% external traffic canary (48 hours measured)

Quick ask: confirm the rollback gating metrics and a short list of runbook owners so we can lock the PO milestone schedule.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@heliosrx.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@heliosrx.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: internal: HeliosRx MAP — ops + training detail (please review)

Marcus / Laura — looping you in on HeliosRx MAP draft attached. Below is an ops-first breakdown; please reply inline with any timing or capacity concerns.

Canary specifics (ops):
- Stage 0: Internal QA (2 business days). Objective: smoke test model, KV cache behavior under typical queries, and end-to-end latency profile. Owner: Marcus Lin.
- Stage 1: External canary (20% traffic) for 48 hours. Traffic shaping handled via smart routing policy; fallback to model-variant v1-quantized if latency SLO breached. Owner: SRE (Marcus) + HeliosRx contact.
- Rollback criteria (any triggers cause immediate rollback to previous variant):
  - 95th percentile latency > 500ms for two consecutive 15-minute windows
  - Error rate (5xx responses) > 0.5% sustained for 10 minutes
  - Embedding-quality regression: precision drop > 3% on 500-sample set or critical regression on the top-30 prompts
- Monitoring hooks: p95 latency, token-cost burn rate, model-delta alerts (quality), and tracing IDs for failed requests

Evaluation plan (ML):
- Baseline run: run 500-sample acceptance set against the pinned model and record metrics (precision/recall-like metrics for HeliosRx prompts).
- Daily drift: automated embedding-distance checks with anomaly scoring (alerts at 2.5 std devs)
- Weekly curated: product team to review 30-edge cases and flag regressions; acceptance requires <= 3 flagged regressions week-over-week during canary

Training + enablement:
- Operator cohorts: 3 sessions (90 minutes each) in the week before external canary — recorded and slides published to the shared drive. Owner: Laura Bennett.
- SRE deep dives: two 60-minute sessions covering runbook play, canary rollback, and observability dashboards. Owner: Marcus Lin.

Dependencies to resolve before internal QA:
- HeliosRx IT: SAML metadata + allowlist
- PO milestone: required to be signed and processed for provisioning (Procurement team needs confirmation by 2026-08-20)

Action items (draft owners):
- Marcus: confirm autoscaling + routing policy and provide the canary IP list (due 2026-08-17)
- Laura: confirm training dates (propose 2026-09-14, 09-15, 09-16)
- Naomi: finalize MAP and share to Drive after approvals

Let me know ASAP if the window or owners look off. I want to avoid shifting the 9/20 internal QA window.

— Naomi

Attachment stubs: HeliosRx_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 68KB); canary-checklist.pdf (pdf, 42KB); training-cadence.docx (docx, 12KB)

> Marcus / Laura — looping you in on HeliosRx MAP draft attached. Below is an ops-first breakdown; please reply inline with any timing or capacity concerns.

Thanks Naomi — this looks great and aligns with Procurement's ask. A few quick confirmations from our side:

- HeliosRx IT will provide SAML metadata and allowlist by 2026-08-18 (we'll push this to you directly)
- Training dates: the proposed cohort dates are fine but can we shift cohort 2 by +1 day to accommodate an internal conference? Proposed sessions: 2026-09-14, 2026-09-16, 2026-09-17 (still in the week before canary)
- Acceptance gating: HeliosRx requests that the final go/no-go decision include one executive sign-off (Aisha) + SRE owner confirmation

Action items for Redwood: please publish the MAP to the shared Drive link and confirm Marcus' canary IP list and autoscaling runbook by Tuesday (2026-08-17). We also need an invoice milestone schedule to match the MAP so our finance team can process the PO.

If you can publish the Drive link with the final MAP and move the training session as noted, we can lock Procurement and start provisioning.

Thanks — looking forward to the runbook review.

— Aisha
Head of Product, HeliosRx
